recipe.visualDefinition: A dual-panel composition featuring a grayscale portrait on the left and a vibrant magenta information block on the right, both enclosed within a thick, purple rounded-rectangle frame against a light olive background.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical balance between the photographic and typographic panels
Contrast between grayscale imagery and high-saturation color blocks
Repetition of rounded corner motifs throughout the layout
Vertical alignment of text elements within the right-hand panel
coreInvariants: Thick purple border with extreme rounded corners
Split-screen layout with a central vertical divide

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Portrait occupies the left half, scaled to fill the frame from chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white condensed display text in the center-right panel.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the portrait, moves right to the primary name, then down to the subtitle and up to the circular badge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight cropping on the portrait; generous magenta space around the text blocks.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements creates a stark contrast with the desaturated grayscale photo.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and widths of the same condensed sans-serif family, using color (white vs yellow) to distinguish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Circular red badge at top right

avoid: Centered text in the right panel

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for the display text.
Matches the extreme verticality and tight counters of the main title.
Offers a cleaner, more modernist take on the condensed sans-serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a split-screen layout with a grayscale 1960s-style portrait of a woman with a beehive hairstyle on the left. The right side is a solid magenta panel. Enclose both in a thick purple rounded-corner frame, set against a light olive green background. Include a small red circle at the top center of the magenta panel.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, white, extra-condensed sans-serif uppercase text in the center of the magenta panel. Below it, add three lines of yellow condensed sans-serif text in title case. Add small white metadata text inside the red circle.

verificationChecks: Are the corners of the main frame and internal panels rounded?
Is the primary text extra-condensed and white?
Is the background of the right panel a vibrant magenta?

avoid: Modern digital filters on the photo

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the purple border is continuous around both panels.
Check that the yellow text is legible against the magenta.
Verify the extra-condensed font doesn't touch the panel edges.
Confirm the grayscale photo has a mid-century grain/texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-screen layout + rounded frame + condensed sans-serif + high-saturation color block + grayscale portrait.
